assertion.statement: cert-manager no longer publishes OperatorHub packages (RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub and operatorhub.io), and v1.16.5 is the last release available there.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The evidence does not say how to tell that an environment installed cert-manager from an OperatorHub/OLM package. None of the listed config sources records how cert-manager was installed, and naming OLM resource kinds would go beyond the evidence.; consequence: The evidence only says that OperatorHub packages are no longer published and that v1.16.5 is the last one. It does not say what happens to existing OperatorHub installations, such as whether upgrades fail or which migration path to use.
